mapper.select: select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, c1.C_Name as icmLegalPersonCName, c2.C_Name as icmGenerationUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as icmLegalPersonAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as icmGenerationAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as legalPersonCNameHistory, c2.C_Name_History as generationUnitNameHistory, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Inv_Control_Manage mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Icm_Legal_Person_Cid=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Icm_Generation_Unit=c2.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Icm_Id where mn.Icm_Id=#{icmId}
